snippet.title: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
*Voice acting for trailer purposes only

The battle for survival is here, and the stakes have never been higher. 
After a brutal Cylon attack, your crew must fight against the clock to repair the ship, manage limited resources, and survive the next wave of danger. As Commander of your fleet, you’ll have to get ready to struggle to balance the needs of the crew with the pressures of war. Can you survive with no nukes, limited scrap, and a constant threat from the Cylons? 
It’s a race against time and fate.

Wishlist Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2535950/Battlestar_Galactica_Scattered_Hopes/ 

In this story-rich tactical roguelite, take command of one of the many fleets escaping the annihilation of the Twelve Colonies, get ready for:
Intense decision-making and resource management
Epic space combat against deadly Cylon forces
Deep narrative-driven gameplay and immersive world-building

The clock is ticking. So say we all.

Stay updated and join the Fleet’s HQ on social media:
💫 X - Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes: https://x.com/playbsg 
💫 Facebook - Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes: https://www.facebook.com/playbsg
